revealWordProblem.title: Apply: Comparing Heights
revealWordProblem.text: Two of the tallest formations on Earth are Mount Everest and Mauna Kea. The summit of Mount Everest is +8,849 meters relative to sea level. Mauna Kea is a dormant volcano on the island of Hawaii; its base sits at -6,005 meters (below sea level) on the ocean floor. How far is each point from sea level? Use absolute value to compare the distances.
revealWordProblem.sampleAnswer: Everest's summit is |+8,849| = 8,849 meters from sea level, and Mauna Kea's base is |-6,005| = 6,005 meters from sea level. Everest's summit is farther from sea level because 8,849 > 6,005.

conceptIntro.heading: Let's build it together — What is absolute value?
conceptIntro.intro: An integer is a whole number that can be positive, negative, or zero. The absolute value of a number is how far it is from zero on the number line. Distance is never negative. We'll walk through a worked example, try one together, then you'll try a few with hints right there when you need them.
conceptIntro.keyIdea: Absolute value tells you the distance from zero, so it is always positive or zero.

iDo.title: Watch me
lines: I want to find the absolute value of -6, written |-6|.
I find -6 on the number line. It sits 6 steps to the left of zero.
Distance does not care about direction, so -6 is 6 units from zero.
So |-6| = 6. Even though -6 is negative, its absolute value is positive 6.

weDo.title: Let's try together
lines: Now let's find |3|. Where is 3 on the number line? It is 3 steps to the right of zero.
How far is it from zero? It is 3 units away.
Sentence frame — say it with me: "The multiples/steps I need are ___ , and the answer is ___ ."

approaching.stem: What is the absolute value of -9?
approaching.explanation: Absolute value is the distance from zero. -9 is 9 units from zero, so |-9| = 9.
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you got the sign backwards. Instead: Absolute value is the distance from zero.
0 sería la respuesta solo si el número fuera cero. Cuenta cuántas unidades hay entre -9 y 0 en la recta numérica.
El 1 no sale de medir la distancia. El valor absoluto cuenta las unidades desde cero hasta el número, sin importar el signo.
hints: Absolute value asks: how FAR is -9 from zero? It's about distance, not direction.
Picture -9 on a number line and count the hops back to 0. A distance is never negative.
Start at -9 and count the steps to reach 0: 1, 2, 3, ... How many hops does it take in all?
approaching.explanationEs: El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero. -9 está a 9 unidades de cero, así que |-9| = 9.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta: ¿qué tan LEJOS está −9 de cero? Se trata de distancia, no de dirección.
Imagina −9 en una recta numérica y cuenta los saltos de regreso a 0. Una distancia nunca es negativa.
Empieza en −9 y cuenta los pasos para llegar a 0: 1, 2, 3, … ¿Cuántos saltos hacen falta en total?

approaching.stem: Which integer has the GREATEST absolute value: -3, 7, -5, 2?
choiceFeedback: |-3| = 3, una de las distancias más cortas de la lista. Compara las distancias desde cero, no los signos.
|2| = 2, la distancia más pequeña de todas. Halla el valor absoluto de cada número y después compáralos.
hints: 'Greatest absolute value' means farthest from zero — the sign doesn't matter.
Find each number's distance from 0: |-3|, |7|, |-5|, |2|. Then pick the biggest distance.
Start with |-3| = 3 and |-5| = 5. Now find the distances for 7 and 2 and compare all four.
approaching.stemEs: ¿Cuál entero tiene el MAYOR valor absoluto: -3, 7, -5, 2?
hintsEs: 'Mayor valor absoluto' significa el más lejano de cero; el signo no importa.
Halla la distancia de cada número a 0: |−3|, |7|, |−5|, |2|. Luego elige la distancia mayor.
Empieza con |−3| = 3 y |−5| = 5. Ahora halla las distancias de 7 y 2 y compara las cuatro.

approaching.explanation: Zero is 0 units from itself on the number line, so |0| = 0.
choiceFeedback: Absolute value is distance from zero, not a change to the digit.
Un valor absoluto nunca puede ser negativo, porque una distancia nunca es negativa.
Sí hay respuesta: el cero también tiene valor absoluto. Pregúntate a qué distancia está el cero de sí mismo.
hints: Absolute value = distance from zero. Here the number inside the bars IS zero.
Ask: how many units do you travel from 0 to reach 0 on the number line?
Place your finger on 0. Count the hops needed to get to 0 — that count is the value of |0|.
approaching.explanationEs: El cero está a 0 unidades de sí mismo en la recta numérica, así que |0| = 0.
hintsEs: Valor absoluto = distancia desde cero. Aquí el número dentro de las barras ES cero.
Pregunta: ¿cuántas unidades recorres desde 0 para llegar a 0 en la recta numérica?
Pon el dedo en 0. Cuenta los saltos necesarios para llegar a 0: ese conteo es el valor de |0|.

approaching.title: The Missing Sign Mistake

workedExample.label: Student's thinking
workedExample.work: The number inside the bars is negative, so I should keep the negative sign in my answer.

approaching.correctWork: Absolute value means the distance a number is from zero, and distance is never negative. -9 is 9 units from zero, so |-9| = 9. The negative sign on the number inside the bars does NOT carry over to the answer — absolute value always gives a positive number or zero.
hints: Can you walk backward -5 steps? Distance is always zero or positive, no matter which direction you moved.
Cross out the negative sign inside the absolute value bars — the answer is always the positive version of the number (or 0).
approaching.titleEs: El error del signo que sobra
approaching.explanation: The student's thinking step assumes the negative sign carries through the bars, but absolute value reports distance from zero and distance is never negative. Since -9 sits 9 units from zero, |-9| = 9.
approaching.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento del estudiante supone que el signo negativo atraviesa las barras, pero el valor absoluto indica la distancia al cero y una distancia nunca es negativa. Como -9 está a 9 unidades del cero, |-9| = 9.

approaching.stem: Which statement about absolute value is TRUE?
choices: |-4| = |4| because both are 4 units from zero
approaching.explanation: Absolute value measures distance from zero. Both -4 and 4 are 4 units from zero, so |-4| = |4| = 4.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. Absolute value measures distance from zero.
Ser positivo no cambia la distancia. Mide cuántas unidades hay desde cada número hasta el cero antes de comparar.
Los negativos no se cancelan dentro de las barras de valor absoluto. Cuenta las unidades que hay desde cero hasta -4.
hints: Remember the definition: absolute value measures DISTANCE from zero, and a distance is never negative.
Test each statement against the definition. Ask: how far is -4 from zero? How far is 4? Can distance be negative?
First count -4's units from zero, then count 4's units from zero. Compare the two counts before judging.
approaching.stemEs: ¿Cuál afirmación sobre el valor absoluto es VERDADERA?
approaching.explanationEs: El valor absoluto mide la distancia desde cero. Tanto -4 como 4 están a 4 unidades de cero, así que |-4| = |4| = 4.
choicesEs: |-4| = |4| porque los dos están a 4 unidades del cero
|4| > |-4| porque lo positivo siempre es mayor
hintsEs: Recuerda la definición: el valor absoluto mide la DISTANCIA desde cero, y una distancia nunca es negativa.
Prueba cada enunciado contra la definición. Pregunta: ¿qué tan lejos está −4 de cero? ¿Y el 4? ¿Puede una distancia ser negativa?
Cuenta primero las unidades de −4 desde cero y luego las del 4 desde cero. Compara los dos conteos antes de juzgar.

approaching.title: Confusing Opposite with Absolute Value

workedExample.label: Problem
workedExample.work: Complete the table for the integer 9: find its absolute value and its opposite.

workedExample.label: Student's thinking
workedExample.work: Absolute value and opposite both just make a number positive, so they should give the same answer as each other.

workedExample.label: Student's answer
workedExample.work: Absolute value of 9 = 9, and opposite of 9 = 9.

approaching.correctWork: Absolute value and opposite are different operations. Absolute value measures distance from zero and is never negative: |9| = 9. Opposite reflects a number to the other side of zero, flipping its sign: the opposite of 9 is -9, not 9. The two operations only give the same result for the number 0 — every other number has a different absolute value and opposite.
hints: The opposite of a number always lands on the OTHER side of zero. Where is -9 compared to 9 on the number line?
Check the fill-table row for 4: its absolute value is 4, but its opposite is -4 — they are different! Now check the row for 9. Does the opposite of a positive number stay positive?
approaching.titleEs: Confundir el opuesto con el valor absoluto
approaching.explanation: The student's thinking step treats absolute value and opposite as the same operation, but they are not. Absolute value gives the distance from zero, so |9| = 9, while the opposite reflects the number across zero, so the opposite of 9 is -9 — the two only agree for the number 0.
approaching.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento del estudiante trata el valor absoluto y el opuesto como la misma operación, pero no lo son. El valor absoluto da la distancia al cero, así que |9| = 9, mientras que el opuesto refleja el número al otro lado del cero, así que el opuesto de 9 es -9; los dos solo coinciden en el número 0.

onLevel.stem: On a frosty morning at the mountain cache, the thermometer reads -8 degrees. What is the absolute value of -8?
onLevel.explanation: Absolute value is the distance from zero, so |-8| = 8.
choiceFeedback: That is what you get if you got the sign backwards. Instead: Absolute value is the distance from zero, so |-___| = ___.
0 sería la respuesta solo si la temperatura fuera cero. Cuenta las unidades que hay entre -8 y 0.
Parece que contaste de -8 hasta 8, o duplicaste la distancia. El valor absoluto solo mide de -8 hasta cero.
onLevel.stemEs: En una mañana helada en el escondite de la montaña, el termómetro marca -8 grados. ¿Cuál es el valor absoluto de -8?
onLevel.explanationEs: El valor absoluto es la distancia desde cero, así que |-8| = 8.
hints: Absolute value asks how far a number is from zero, not which side of zero it is on.
Picture -8 on a number line and count the steps back to 0.
Start at -8 and move toward zero one unit at a time, keeping track of how many steps that takes.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto pregunta qué tan lejos está un número de cero, no de qué lado de cero está.
Imagina -8 en una recta numérica y cuenta los pasos de regreso hasta 0.
Empieza en -8 y avanza hacia cero de una unidad a la vez, llevando la cuenta de cuántos pasos toma.

onLevel.stem: Two treasure sites report their temperatures: -5 degrees F at the Ice Cave and -2 degrees F at the Frozen Dock. Which site is COLDER?
onLevel.explanation: On a number line, -5 is to the left of -2, so -5 is the smaller (colder) temperature.
choiceFeedback: Not quite. On a number line, ___ is to the left of -2, so ___ is the smaller (colder) temperature.
-5 y -2 no son iguales; ocupan puntos distintos en la recta numérica. Compara sus posiciones, no solo sus signos.
Los dos números llevan signo negativo, así que los dos están por debajo de cero. Ubícalos en la recta numérica para compararlos.
onLevel.stemEs: Dos sitios del tesoro reportan sus temperaturas: -5 grados F en la Cueva de Hielo y -2 grados F en el Muelle Congelado. ¿Cuál sitio está MÁS FRÍO?
onLevel.explanationEs: En una recta numérica, -5 está a la izquierda de -2, así que -5 es la temperatura menor (más fría).
hints: Colder means the smaller number, and on a number line smaller always means farther to the left.
Sketch a number line with 0 in the middle and place both negative temperatures on it.
Put -2 and -5 on the line and notice which one sits farther to the left of zero, then use that to decide.
hintsEs: Más frío significa el número menor, y en una recta numérica menor siempre significa más a la izquierda.
Dibuja una recta numérica con el 0 en el medio y ubica las dos temperaturas negativas.
Coloca -2 y -5 en la recta y fíjate cuál queda más a la izquierda del cero; usa eso para decidir.

onLevel.stem: Captain Vega compares |-12| (a deep cave) and |7| (a hilltop). Which absolute value is GREATER?
onLevel.explanation: |-12| = 12 and |7| = 7. Since 12 > 7, the absolute value of -12 is greater.
choiceFeedback: Absolute value measures distance from zero, so the original sign does not decide which is larger.
12 y 7 no son la misma distancia desde cero. Halla cada valor absoluto por separado y después compáralos.
Un valor absoluto nunca es negativo, porque es una distancia. Vuelve a calcular |-12| contando unidades desde cero.
onLevel.stemEs: La capitana Vega compara |-12| (una cueva profunda) y |7| (una cima). ¿Cuál valor absoluto es MAYOR?
onLevel.explanationEs: |-12| = 12 y |7| = 7. Como 12 > 7, el valor absoluto de -12 es mayor.
hints: Absolute value turns each number into a distance from zero, and distances are never negative.
Find |-12| and |7| separately before you compare anything.
-12 sits 12 units from zero. Work out how far 7 sits from zero, then compare those two distances.
hintsEs: El valor absoluto convierte cada número en una distancia desde cero, y las distancias nunca son negativas.
Halla |-12| y |7| por separado antes de comparar cualquier cosa.
-12 está a 12 unidades de cero. Calcula a qué distancia está 7 de cero y luego compara esas dos distancias.

onLevel.title: Level 2 Extension — The Colder Temperature Mistake

workedExample.label: Mission
workedExample.work: Captain Vega asks: which is colder, -8 degrees F or -2 degrees F?

workedExample.label: Crew member's reasoning
workedExample.work: 8 is bigger than 2, so -8 must be the warmer one.

workedExample.label: Crew member's answer
workedExample.work: -2 degrees F is colder than -8 degrees F.

onLevel.correctWork: For negative numbers, the one farther left on the number line is colder. -8 is to the LEFT of -2, so -8 degrees F is colder than -2 degrees F. Comparing the digits 8 and 2 only works for positive numbers; with negatives the order flips.
hints: Picture a number line. Which temperature sits farther to the left of zero?
With negative numbers, a larger digit (like 8) means the number is actually smaller and colder.
onLevel.titleEs: Extensión de Nivel 2 — el error de la temperatura más fría
onLevel.explanation: The reasoning step compares the digits 8 and 2 as if the numbers were positive. On a number line -8 sits farther left than -2, and farther left means colder, so -8 degrees F is the colder temperature — with negatives, a bigger digit means a smaller value.
onLevel.explanationEs: El paso del razonamiento compara los dígitos 8 y 2 como si los números fueran positivos. En una recta numérica, -8 queda más a la izquierda que -2, y más a la izquierda significa más frío, así que -8 grados F es la temperatura más fría: con los negativos, un dígito mayor significa un valor menor.

onLevel.title: Find the Absolute Value Error

workedExample.label: Student thinking
workedExample.work: The number is -6, and absolute value makes it the opposite

workedExample.label: Student answer
workedExample.work: |-6| = 6, and since we take the opposite, the answer is -6

onLevel.correctWork: Absolute value gives the DISTANCE from zero, which is always positive or zero. |-6| = 6. The student incorrectly applied 'opposite' a second time.
hints: Absolute value measures distance. Can a distance ever be negative?
The student found 6 first, then incorrectly negated it. Distance from zero is always non-negative.
onLevel.titleEs: Encuentra el error de valor absoluto
onLevel.explanation: The student found |-6| = 6 correctly and then took the opposite a second time, landing back on -6. Absolute value is a distance from zero, so it stops at 6 — there is no extra sign flip after the bars come off.
onLevel.explanationEs: El estudiante halló |-6| = 6 correctamente y luego volvió a tomar el opuesto, regresando a -6. El valor absoluto es una distancia al cero, así que se detiene en 6: no hay otro cambio de signo después de quitar las barras.

onLevel.prompt: A submarine is at -150 meters and a bird is flying at +150 meters. A student says the submarine is closer to sea level because -150 is less than 150. Is the student correct? Explain using absolute value.
onLevel.sentenceFrame: The student is ___ because absolute value measures ___. Since |-150| = ___ and |150| = ___, both are ___ from sea level. The student confused ___ with ___.
onLevel.hint: Use examples with specific coordinates to explain your thinking.
hints: 'Closer to sea level' is about DISTANCE from 0, not about which number is less.
Compare |-150| and |150| — the distances. Then separately note that -150 < 150 is about position, not distance.
Start by finding |-150|: the submarine's distance from sea level in meters. Then find the bird's distance and compare.
onLevel.explanation: The student is not correct. Absolute value measures distance from sea level, and |-150| = 150 while |150| = 150, so the submarine and the bird are exactly the same distance from 0. The comparison -150 < 150 describes position — below versus above sea level — not closeness to it.
onLevel.explanationEs: El estudiante no tiene razón. El valor absoluto mide la distancia al nivel del mar, y |-150| = 150 mientras que |150| = 150, así que el submarino y el ave están exactamente a la misma distancia de 0. La comparación -150 < 150 describe la posición —debajo o encima del nivel del mar—, no la cercanía a él.
onLevel.promptEs: Un submarino está a -150 metros y un ave vuela a +150 metros. Un estudiante dice que el submarino está más cerca del nivel del mar porque -150 es menor que 150. ¿Tiene razón? Explica usando el valor absoluto.
hintsEs: 'Más cerca del nivel del mar' se trata de la DISTANCIA desde 0, no de qué número es menor.
Compara |−150| y |150|, las distancias. Y aparte, nota que −150 < 150 se trata de la posición, no de la distancia.
Empieza hallando |−150|: la distancia del submarino al nivel del mar en metros. Luego halla la distancia del ave y compara.

practice.commonMistake: A common mistake in Integers and Absolute Value is judging size by the digits alone instead of position on the number line — students think -8 is 'more' than -3 because 8 > 3, when really -8 sits farther left (colder, deeper, or lower) and is actually the SMALLER integer. Absolute value measures distance from zero and is always positive or zero, but that distance does not decide which integer is greater — only left-to-right order on the number line does. Before you submit, ask: am I comparing distance from zero (absolute value) or position on the number line (greater/less than)?

check.stem: Which craft is FARTHER from sea level?
check.explanation: Compare absolute values: |200| = 200 and |−150| = 150. The helicopter is farther from sea level, even though the submarine's number looks 'more extreme' with its minus sign.

check.stem: Which craft is at the LOWER position?
check.explanation: Position uses the signed value: −150 is below 0 and 200 is above it. Sign tells you direction; absolute value tells you distance.

connect.modelAnswer: The submarine is at −150 m and the helicopter is at +200 m. Their absolute values — |−150| = 150 and |200| = 200 — give the distance each is from sea level, ignoring direction. The helicopter is actually farther from sea level (200 m vs 150 m), even though the submarine is the one below it. Sign tells direction; absolute value tells distance.

exitTicket.stem: Quick check — you've got this: Which integer has an absolute value of 8 and is located to the LEFT of zero on the number line?
exitTicket.explanation: To the left of zero means negative. The integer -8 has an absolute value of 8 because it is 8 units from zero.
choiceFeedback: 8 is to the RIGHT of zero — you need the negative side.
Zero's absolute value is 0, not 8 — find distance 8 left.
Its absolute value is 80, not 8 — check the distance from zero.
hints: Two clues to satisfy: distance from zero = 8, AND the point sits to the LEFT of zero.
Left of zero means negative. So you need the negative number that is exactly 8 units from 0.
Start at 0 and count 8 ticks to the LEFT. Check that the number you land on really has absolute value 8.

questions.stem: A point is at (6, 2). What does the 6 tell you?
questions.explanation: The first number (x-coordinate) tells you horizontal movement. 6 means go right 6 units from the origin.

questions.stem: What are the coordinates of the origin?
questions.explanation: The origin is where the x-axis and y-axis cross, at (0, 0).

questions.stem: Which ordered pair names a point 3 units right and 7 units up from the origin?
questions.explanation: The first coordinate is horizontal (right 3), the second is vertical (up 7). So (3, 7).
